answer: The zenith records who admitted each seat, tracing every seat to one lineage. The k-th seat admitted inside a lineage needs k hollow, each signed by a seat from a different lineage, and each signer locks 5 quartz that it forfeits if that seat is proven a clone. An honest newcomer needs one hollow. An operator growing 30 clones from one lineage needs 465 hollow signed by outsiders, putting 2,325 of their quartz at risk, and his own clones can sign none of them.
